vllm.router_trace_emit.directive: Expose vLLM's MoE router decisions per-(token, layer) during inference. Latest vLLM ships a first-class path via `enable_return_routed_experts=True` on `AsyncEngineArgs`: each `CompletionOutput` then carries a `routed_experts` ndarray (shape ~ `[seq_position, moe_layer, top_k]`, length `num_prompt_tokens + num_generated_tokens - 1`, expert IDs in `[0, num_experts)`). Reference: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/examples/rl/routed_experts_e2e/ . Path: add `scripts/live/run_vllm_moe_rollout.py` that constructs `AsyncEngineArgs(model=Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B, enable_return_routed_experts=True, tensor_parallel_size=4, max_model_len=4096, disable_log_stats=True, attention_backend='FLASH_ATTN')`, drives `AsyncLLM.from_engine_args(...).generate(prompt, SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=N), uuid)`, then reads `final.outputs[0].routed_experts` and `final.outputs[0].token_ids`. Write `/tmp/vllm_router.json` in the same shape as `/tmp/megatron_router.json` ({model, prompt_token_ids, response_token_ids, num_layers, num_experts, top_k, expert_ids[token][layer][top_k], engine, engine_fingerprint}). Caveat: this returns *selected* expert IDs only, not gate logits — sufficient for `router_flip_rate` (top-1 set comparison). Add `tests/test_vllm_router_trace_shape.py` that loads a `/tmp/megatron_router.json` fixture and asserts a stub vLLM trace is shape-compatible (same num_tokens × num_layers × top_k). Evidence: the new script + test file. Honor STEER.md global directives.

hermes_agent.proxy_enable_thinking_off.directive: Cycle-3 v2 (probe-at-rollout) UNBLOCKER. Qwen3 (both Dense and MoE) ships with reasoning mode on; the <think>...</think> blocks blew past 131K context in 3 turns during the 2026-05-12 Hermes-MoE summarize-repo smoke (1658s DNF: 'Context length exceeded: max compression attempts (3) reached'). /no_think in the user content is NOT a fix — Qwen3 reads it as plain text. Only chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false at the OpenAI body level disables it (Qwen3's chat template documents this). Patch scripts/live/logprob_capture_proxy.py::inject_logprobs to setdefault('chat_template_kwargs', {}).setdefault('enable_thinking', False). Preserve the caller's explicit choice (idempotency); honor the existing inject pattern for logprobs/top_logprobs/return_token_ids. Add two unit tests in tests/test_logprob_capture_proxy.py: (a) inject_disables_thinking_by_default (chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking is False after the call when absent in the input body), (b) inject_preserves_caller_thinking_choice (when the caller sets enable_thinking=True the proxy leaves it alone). After the patch lands, run the MoE summarize-repo smoke through the proxy (HERMES_INSTALL.md flow + base_url pointed at the proxy on port 8001 instead of vLLM on 8000) and verify wall-clock drops from 1658s to <90s. Evidence: tests passing + .claude/evidence/hermes_proxy_enable_thinking/smoke.txt containing the new wall-clock + the rendered 5-bullet repo summary. Honor STEER.md global directives (one entry per commit).

The proxy already captures both (logprob_capture_proxy.py::extract_probes lifts prompt_routed_experts from the response top level and response_routed_experts from choices[0]). The merger writes both into the sidecar record. But AgentStep only declares response_routed_experts — the prompt-side array is dropped on the floor. Add prompt_routed_experts: list[list[list[int]]] | None = None to AgentStep with the same docstring + validator shape (list of lists of lists of ints, length parity if response_token_ids is present). Mirror the validator branch from response_routed_experts. Thread the field through adapt_hermes_record AND adapt_hermes_sharegpt_trajectory (it lives in _PROBE_FIELDS so the same _extract_probes path picks it up automatically once added there). Thread through merge_probes_into_trajectories.py (one line in _build_record). Add 3 tests: (a) AgentStep accepts and round-trips prompt_routed_experts in test_agent_trajectory_lab.py; (b) adapt_hermes_record passes prompt_routed_experts through in test_hermes_agent_runner_adapter.py; (c) the merger threads prompt_routed_experts onto an AgentStep in test_merge_probes_into_trajectories.py. ACCEPTANCE: a fixture trajectory carries both prompt + response routing arrays end-to-end through the proxy → merger → AgentStep seam without drops. Evidence: the 3 new tests passing under .claude/evidence/hermes_prompt_routed_experts/. Honor STEER.md.

hermes_agent.router_pair_handle_minus_on.directive: Cycle-3 v2 (probe-at-rollout) UNBLOCKER. vLLM's routed_experts replay marks prefix-cached positions with -1 sentinel (https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/training/routed_experts_replay/ caveats section). Today scripts/live/pair_hermes_moe_reports.py would treat -1 as a real expert ID, inflating router_flip_rate when the rollout side has -1 (cached) but the trainer side has a real expert ID. Filter -1 positions from the flip-rate computation BEFORE comparing rollout vs trainer routing. Surface a new field skipped_prefix_cached_positions: int on the rendered RouterMismatchReport (existing src/rollout_market/observatory/router_mismatch_lab.py contract) so dashboards can show how much of a trajectory's routing came from prefix cache.
